resources.string: Scan once and both stay in sync over your home network while Sumizuri is open on this computer.
Scan it with the camera of the phone. If the camera does not open Sumizuri, copy the link and paste it in Settings, Sync as the server address.

Only go on if you just showed this code on your own computer (%1$s). Your library will sync with it.
This device already syncs with a server. Sign out of it first to link with another computer.
That code is not a valid Sumizuri code for a home network.
That code was used or is too old. Show a new one on the computer.
This computer already syncs with another server. Sign out of it first to link a phone this way.
The server of this computer could not start. The log in Diagnostics says more.

The computer did not answer. Both must be on the same Wi-Fi, Sumizuri must be open there, and its firewall must allow it.
